data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, the goddess Venus was said to have created the myrtle tree from the tears she shed for Adonis. The myrtle tree was then used to adorn temples and graves, symbolizing death and resurrection. In the Bible, myrtle is mentioned several times, often in connection with the Temple in Jerusalem. The name Myrtle carries the meaning “Myrtle is a feminine name derived from the Greek word 'muron', meaning 'myrtle tree'.” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
